title: Link new device

enter.heading: On the new device, open Veeloe and choose Use with a device I already have
enter.footer: Scan the QR code it shows, or paste its link here. Linking is only for your own devices.
enter.noCamera: Veeloe can't use the camera here. Paste the link instead.

name.heading: New device
name.label: Name of the new device
name.footer: This device will vouch for the new device's key, and the new device will be able to command all your Machines. Only approve a device that is in front of you.
name.taken: You already have a device called {{name}}

prompt: Link {{name}}. This device will vouch for its key

sending.heading: Sending your Machines to the new device…
sending.body: Keep the app open on the new device until this finishes.
